transcript: Speaker A: हम आपको continue नहीं कर सकते। अगर नौकरी चाहिए तो English सीख कर आओ। हमारे सभी subjects English medium में हैं। Parents और students सभी complain कर रहे हैं। आप class में English में explain नहीं कर पाते, यह कब तक चलेगा? [We cannot continue with you. If you want a job, learn English and come back. All our subjects are in English medium. Parents and students are all complaining. You cannot explain in English in class, how long will this go on?] Speaker B: 3 साल से पढ़ा रही थी, बच्चे मुझे पसंद भी करते थे। मुझे बस English नहीं आती थी। और बस एक चीज़ की वजह से मेरी नौकरी चली गई। इसलिए मैंने English Seekho app install किया। इसमें रोज़ की बोलचाल के लिए videos हैं, घर की चीज़ों से English सीखी, किसी से पहली बार मिलो तो क्या बोलो, interview में क्या बोलो सब कुछ सीखा। दिशा मैम के साथ भी practice करी। AI हैं, judge नहीं करतीं। रात को भी available हैं। गलती पर सीधा बता देती हैं क्या सही था। धीरे-धीरे वो बोलने का डर और झिझक, वो भी चली गई। [I was teaching for 3 years, the kids liked me too. I just didn't know English. And just because of one thing, I lost my job. That's why I installed the English Seekho app. It has videos for daily conversation, I learned English from household items, what to say when meeting someone for the first time, what to say in an interview, I learned everything. I also practiced with Disha Ma'am. She is AI, she doesn't judge. She is available at night too. She directly tells you what was correct when you make a mistake. Gradually, the fear and hesitation of speaking also went away.] Speaker C: Sukanya, tell me, how would you explain the water cycle to Class 5 students? Speaker B: I'd start with something they already know. I'd ask them why their clothes dry after playing. From there we build up to evaporation, condensation, rainfall. Real examples first, technical terms after. Speaker C: That's actually a very good approach. Speaker B: Principal ने कहा था, English सीख कर आओ। मैं सीख के आई। आप भी बस 1 रुपये में तीन दिन का trial ले कर देखो और English Seekho. English Seekho install करो और English बोलना सीखो। [The principal said, learn English and come back. I learned it. You too take a 3-day trial for just 1 rupee and learn English. Install English Seekho and learn to speak English.]
